name: Affliction
note: Three degrees, Cumulative, Progressive, Extra Condition, Limited Degree and end-of-turn recovery work; Deaf, Transformed and other minor conditions do little and durations are ignored.

name: Alternate Form
note: Alternate forms are not switched in a fight.

name: Blast
note: Fights as Damage at range (DCA 89).

name: Burrowing
note: Burrowing is not counted as movement and no one goes underground.

name: Communication
note: Communication has no effect on a fight.

name: Comprehend
note: Languages and comprehension do not matter in a fight.

name: Concealment
note: Visual concealment gives -2 or -5 to attacks against the holder; other senses and non-visual concealment are ignored.

name: Create
note: Created objects and barriers are not simulated.

name: Damage
note: Toughness check at 15 + rank with cumulative bruises, dazed, staggered and incapacitated; Strength gives built-in close Damage.

name: Dazzle
note: Fought as an Affliction (impaired, disabled, unaware) but the sense it blocks is not tracked.

name: Deflect
note: There is no reaction to turn a ranged attack aside.

name: Duplication
note: Duplicates are not created.

name: Element Control
note: Control effects (Move Object style) are not simulated.

name: Elongation
note: Stretching and extra reach are not modelled.

name: Energy Absorption
note: Absorbing energy attacks into Enhanced Traits is not simulated.

name: Energy Aura
note: Fights as Damage that is used like a normal attack; its automatic Reaction against attackers is not simulated.

name: Energy Control
note: Fights as Damage at range; the other uses of an energy power are not simulated.

name: Enhanced Trait
note: Abilities, defenses and skills are added to the derived numbers; Enhanced Advantage is not.

name: Environment
note: Environmental changes such as darkness or heat are not simulated.

name: Extra Limbs
note: Extra limbs (holding while attacking) are not modelled.

name: Feature
note: A feature is descriptive only.

name: Flight
note: Sets how far the fighter moves each turn and the log wording; nothing else about flying (height, ground effects) is modelled.

name: Force Field
note: Counts as sustained Protection with Impervious; Nullify can switch it off.

name: Growth
note: Strength, Stamina, Dodge, Parry, Intimidation and Stealth change; extra reach and size effects do not.

name: Healing
note: Healers restore bruises, dazed and staggered at DC 10; Healing's other uses such as stabilizing a dying hero are not simulated.

name: Illusion
note: Illusions are not simulated.

name: Immortality
note: Returning after incapacitation is not simulated.

name: Immunity
note: Immunity is matched by text against attack descriptors and defenses, including half effect; unusual immunities may be missed.

name: Insubstantial
note: Insubstantial forms and the damage they avoid are not simulated.

name: Invisibility
note: Treated as visual Concealment; other senses are ignored.

name: Leaping
note: Counts as half its rank toward movement; jumping over things is not modelled.

name: Luck Control
note: Rerolls forced on other characters are not simulated.

name: Magic
note: Fights as Damage at range; the flexible casting that Magic allows is not simulated.

name: Mental Blast
note: Perception range Damage resisted by Will, with no attack roll.

name: Mimic
note: Copying traits from a target is not simulated.

name: Mind Control
note: Dazed, compelled and controlled work (a controlled fighter attacks its own side); the controller's other orders are not.

name: Mind Reading
note: Reading minds has no combat effect here.

name: Morph
note: Changing appearance has no combat effect here.

name: Move Object
note: Moving or throwing objects with a power is not simulated.

name: Movement
note: Special movement types are not counted.

name: Nullify
note: Opposed check against sustained protection only; other powers cannot be nullified.

name: Power-Lifting
note: Only changes how much can be lifted.

name: Protection
note: Adds to Toughness, with Impervious and Sustained handled.

name: Quickness
note: Only speeds up routine tasks.

name: Regeneration
note: Recovers one damage condition per round using a simplified rank count; the book's recovery timings are not followed.

name: Remote Sensing
note: Sensing from afar has no combat effect here.

name: Senses
note: Only senses that see through concealment (radar, tremor, danger sense and the like) are used.

name: Shapeshift
note: Changing form in a fight is not simulated.

name: Shrinking
note: Strength, Dodge and Parry change; Stealth and small-size effects do not.

name: Sleep
note: Fought as Fortitude Affliction (fatigued, exhausted, asleep); waking from noise or damage is not simulated.

name: Snare
note: Hindered and vulnerable, then defenseless and immobile, resisted by Dodge; escaping by Strength is not simulated.

name: Speed
note: Sets how far the fighter moves each turn; Speed is not used for chasing or running away.

name: Strike
note: Fights as Damage (DCA 117).

name: Suffocation
note: Fought as a progressive Fortitude Affliction; holding breath and the book's conditions are not followed.

name: Summon
note: Summoned allies are not created.

name: Super-Speed
note: Not counted as movement, and the Improved Initiative it grants is not applied.

name: Swimming
note: Counts as movement speed; water is not in the arena.

name: Teleport
note: Counts as movement speed; Teleport Attack and ranged placement are not simulated.

name: Transform
note: Transformations are not simulated.

name: Variable
note: Only Omni-power fighters reconfigure, into four fixed attacks sized to half the points.

name: Weaken
note: Weakens one trait guessed from the power's detail and returns a rank each round; the book's recovery rate differs.

name: Accurate
note: Adds +2 to the attack bonus per step.

name: Affects Corporeal
note: Only matters with Insubstantial, which is not simulated.

name: Affects Insubstantial
note: Insubstantial is not simulated.

name: Affects Objects
note: Objects are not in the fight.

name: Affects Others
note: Defenses and powers cannot be given to allies in a fight.

name: Alternate Effect
note: Alternate attacks are separate attack choices, switched for free; alternate defenses and utilities are ignored.

name: Alternate Resistance
note: The attack uses the resistance recorded on the power; the cost changes are not checked.

name: Area
note: Burst, Cone and the rest all hit everyone in one zone with Dodge for half; shapes are not modelled.

name: Attack
note: An Attack extra on a non-attack effect does not make it an attack.

name: Contagious
note: Spreading effects are not simulated.

name: Dimensional
note: Dimensions are not simulated.

name: Extended Range
note: Range bands in the fight do not scale with Extended Range.

name: Feature
note: Descriptive only.

name: Homing
note: Homing attacks are not simulated.

name: Impervious
note: Impervious Protection ignores attacks of half its rank or less unless Penetrating.

name: Increased Duration
note: Durations beyond instant are not tracked.

name: Increased Mass
note: Needs Move Object, which is not simulated.

name: Increased Range
note: Changes the attack from close to ranged through the power's range; distance is counted in zones, not by rank.

name: Incurable
note: Effects that resist Healing and Regeneration are not simulated.

name: Indirect
note: Needs cover and line of sight, which are not simulated.

name: Innate
note: Innate powers are not protected from Nullify.

name: Insidious
note: Concerns detecting an effect after the fight.

name: Linked
note: Linked powers show as separate attacks instead of one combined action.

name: Multiattack
note: Two degrees of success add +2 to the resistance DC, three or more add +5.

name: Penetrating
note: Overcomes Impervious.

name: Precise
note: Fine control has no combat meaning.

name: Reach
note: Reach is not modelled.

name: Reaction
note: Reactions are not simulated, apart from Energy Aura as a normal attack.

name: Reversible
note: Reversing an effect has no combat meaning.

name: Ricochet
note: Attacks cannot bounce.

name: Secondary Effect
note: Second effects are not simulated.

name: Selective
note: Area attacks skip allies.

name: Sleep
note: Sleep instead of incapacitation is not applied to Damage; the Sleep effect is separate.

name: Split
note: Splitting an attack among targets is not simulated.

name: Subtle
note: Concerns being noticed.

name: Sustained
note: Only Sustained Protection is used (and can be nullified).

name: Triggered
note: Triggered effects are not simulated.

name: Variable Descriptor
note: Descriptors are fixed.

name: Activation
note: Activation time is not charged.

name: Check Required
note: Required checks are not rolled.

name: Concentration
note: Concentration is not tracked.

name: Diminished Range
note: Range is not reduced by the flaw.

name: Distracting
note: The vulnerability from using the power is not applied.

name: Fades
note: Fading uses are not tracked.

name: Feedback
note: Damage to the user is not applied.

name: Grab-Based
note: Grab-based powers are not tied to a hold.

name: Inaccurate
note: The -2 to hit is not applied.

name: Increased Action
note: Slower actions are not charged.

name: Limited
note: Read only for Immunity (half effect), Concealment and Limited Degree; other limits are not enforced.

name: Noticeable
note: Concerns being noticed.

name: Permanent
note: Only changes cost.

name: Quirk
note: Roleplaying only.

name: Reduced Range
note: Range is not reduced by the flaw.

name: Removable
note: Items are never taken away.

name: Resistible
note: The extra resistance check is not applied.

name: Sense-Dependent
note: Senses are not tracked for powers.

name: Side Effect
note: Side effects are not applied.

name: Tiring
note: Fatigue from using the power is not applied.

name: Uncontrolled
note: Random results are not applied.

name: Unreliable
note: Uses that may fail are not rolled.

name: Accurate Attack
note: Trade rank for attack bonus, up to 5 with the advantage and 2 without.

name: All-out Attack
note: Trade defense for attack bonus, up to 4 with the advantage.

name: Chokehold
note: Only makes the fighter likely to grab; the suffocation it causes is not applied.

name: Close Attack
note: Adds to the close attack bonus in derive.

name: Defensive Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for defense, up to 4 with the advantage.

name: Defensive Roll
note: Adds to Toughness in derive.

name: Evasion
note: Bonus to Dodge against area attacks, and a clean dodge on two degrees.

name: Fast Grab
note: A successful unarmed hit can turn into a grab as a free action.

name: Favored Environment
note: Environments are not simulated.

name: Grabbing Finesse
note: Grabs always use Strength and Fighting.

name: Improved Aim
note: Aim bonuses are the base +5 or +2.

name: Improved Critical
note: Widens the critical threat range per rank (16-20 at four).

name: Improved Defense
note: The extra bonus when defending is not applied.

name: Improved Disarm
note: Disarm is not simulated.

name: Improved Grab
note: Only makes the fighter likely to grab; keeping a free hand is not modelled.

name: Improved Hold
note: Held foes face a harder escape (+5 to the hold DC).

name: Improved Initiative
note: +4 to initiative per rank.

name: Improved Smash
note: Smash is not simulated.

name: Improved Trip
note: Trip is not simulated.

name: Improvised Weapon
note: Improvised weapons are not simulated.

name: Move-by Action
note: Speedster-style fighters hit and then step away; other fighters never split movement around an attack.

name: Power Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for rank, up to 5 with the advantage and 2 without.

name: Precise Attack
note: Each rank ignores the cover or concealment penalty for one pairing of close or ranged attacks, such as Ranged, Cover.

name: Prone Fighting
note: The prone attack penalty is always applied.

name: Quick Draw
note: Drawing weapons is not simulated.

name: Ranged Attack
note: Adds to the ranged attack bonus in derive.

name: Redirect
note: Redirecting a missed attack is not simulated.

name: Set-up
note: Handing a bonus to an ally is not simulated.

name: Takedown
note: A free attack against the next minion after taking one out; chains up to five.

name: Throwing Mastery
note: Thrown weapons are not simulated.

name: Uncanny Dodge
note: The fighter is stunned but not vulnerable in a surprise round.

name: Weapon Bind
note: Reactions to disarm are not simulated.

name: Weapon Break
note: Reactions to attack weapons are not simulated.

name: Beginner's Luck
note: Skill ranks are not boosted in a fight.

name: Inspire
note: Granting bonuses to allies is not simulated.

name: Leadership
note: Removing conditions from allies with a hero point is not simulated.

name: Luck
note: Adds one hero point per rank, usable on any hero point use, instead of a re-roll once per round.

name: Seize Initiative
note: The fighter goes first, but no hero point is spent.

name: Ultimate Effort
note: Automatic 20s are not simulated.

name: Assessment
note: Insight reads of a foe's numbers are not simulated.

name: Benefit
note: A perk with no combat rule.

name: Diehard
note: There is no dying state to stabilize from.

name: Eidetic Memory
note: Memory has no combat rule.

name: Equipment
note: Gear is read from the character, not from the advantage.

name: Extraordinary Effort
note: Double extra effort is not simulated.

name: Fearless
note: Immune to attacks the engine recognizes as fear effects (by wording) and to Demoralize, and never flees.

name: Feature
note: Descriptive only.

name: Great Endurance
note: The bonus to resist fatigue is not applied.

name: Instant Up
note: Standing up is not simulated.

name: Interpose
note: A guard in the same zone takes a hit meant for a weaker ally once per round; not against area or perception attacks.

name: Minion
note: Minions are built as separate combatants.

name: Second Chance
note: Rerolls against hazards are not simulated.

name: Sidekick
note: Sidekicks are built as separate combatants.

name: Teamwork
note: Adds +5 to the Aid attack check (Aid is treated as the team check); other team checks are not simulated.

name: Trance
note: Has no combat rule.

name: Agile Feint
note: Feint with Acrobatics instead of Deception; the feint makes the target vulnerable to the feinter's next attack.

name: Animal Empathy
note: Out of combat skill use.

name: Artificer
note: Out of combat crafting.

name: Attractive
note: Social only.

name: Connected
note: Social only.

name: Contacts
note: Social only.

name: Daze
note: Dazing with Intimidation or Deception is not simulated.

name: Fascinate
note: Fascinating a foe is not simulated.

name: Favored Foe
note: The bonus against a chosen foe is not applied.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
note: Stealth is not simulated.

name: Improvised Tools
note: Out of combat skill use.

name: Inventor
note: Out of combat crafting.

name: Jack-of-all-trades
note: Untrained skill use is not simulated.

name: Languages
note: Language has no combat meaning.

name: Ritualist
note: Rituals are not simulated.

name: Skill Mastery
note: Skill checks are not simulated.

name: Startle
note: Startle as a feint is not simulated.

name: Taunt
note: Lets the fighter demoralize with Deception instead of Intimidation; targets resist with Deception, Insight or Will.

name: Tracking
note: Out of combat skill use.

name: Well-informed
note: Social only.

name: Aid
note: A standard action: an attack check against DC 10; the ally gets +2 (or +5 on four or more degrees) on attacks against a foe, or to defense against it, until the end of the ally's next turn. The AI aids when its own attack is poor and an ally engaged with the foe has a better one, or the ally is staggered; Aid the Champion does it by tactic. Bonuses do not stack.

name: Aim
note: Aiming gives +5 (close) or +2 (farther), leaves the fighter vulnerable, and must be followed by the attack.

name: Attack
note: d20 against 10 + Parry or Dodge, natural 20 hits and natural 1 misses.

name: Charge
note: Move and then attack at -2, covering up to twice the speed.

name: Defend
note: Attackers face an opposed defense roll with 1-10 counting as 11-20; the AI only picks it when hurt and outnumbered.

name: Delay
note: Only minion squads delay, to make a team attack.

name: Demoralize
note: A standard action: Intimidation (or Deception with Taunt) against the target's Insight or Will check; impaired until the end of the demoralizer's next round, disabled on four or more degrees. Enemy minions in earshot are demoralized by one check. The AI uses it with a skill 5 or more above the target's resistance and a weak attack, against a crowd of three or more minions, or on a team's orders (Intimidate and Break). Fearless fighters are immune; the range is two zones.

name: Disarm
note: Disarming is not simulated.

name: Drop Prone
note: Fighters are knocked prone by effects but never drop prone on purpose.

name: Escape
note: Athletics or Sleight of Hand against the hold ends a grab; the free move afterwards is not taken.

name: Grab
note: Attack check then Strength against Strength or Dodge, restrained or bound; the holder's own penalties and later cumulative grabs are not applied.

name: Move
note: Speed rank is turned into 1 to 5 arena zones per turn; real distances are not tracked.

name: Ready
note: Readied actions are not simulated.

name: Recover
note: Once per fight, whole turn, removes the worst damage or fatigue and gives +2 to defenses.

name: Smash
note: Attacking held objects is not simulated.

name: Stand
note: Standing from prone is not simulated.

name: Trick
note: Tricks with Deception are not simulated.

name: Trip
note: Tripping is not simulated.

name: Crawl
note: Prone fighters do not crawl at half speed.

name: Command
note: Orders to minions and thralls are not simulated.

name: Accurate Attack
note: Trade rank for attack bonus, 2 by default and 5 with the advantage.

name: All-out Attack
note: Trade defense for attack bonus, chosen by brawlers, tanks, beasts and minions.

name: Defensive Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for defense, chosen by duelists and supports under pressure.

name: Finishing Attack
note: Any hit on a defenseless target is a critical; the routine check and the kill rule are not used.

name: Power Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for rank, chosen when it raises the expected harm.

name: Slam Attack
note: A charging fighter uses its movement rank as Damage and, with the optional knockback rule on, throws the target back; the extra +1 for a full move and the damage the slammer takes are not applied.

name: Surprise Attack
note: Only through the Ambush option; stealth and unusual tactics do not make a target vulnerable.

name: Team Attack
note: Only minion squads combine attacks (+2 or +5 rank); heroes never team up.

name: Feint
note: Deception (or Acrobatics with Agile Feint) against Insight or Deception; on success the target is vulnerable to the feinter's next attack until the end of the feinter's next round (DCA 64).

name: Trick
note: Tricks with Deception are not simulated.

name: Demoralize
note: A standard action: Intimidation (or Deception with Taunt) against the target's Insight or Will check; impaired until the end of the demoralizer's next round, disabled on four or more degrees. Enemy minions in earshot are demoralized by one check. The AI uses it with a skill 5 or more above the target's resistance and a weak attack, against a crowd of three or more minions, or on a team's orders (Intimidate and Break). Fearless fighters are immune; the range is two zones.

name: Aid
note: A standard action: an attack check against DC 10; the ally gets +2 (or +5 on four or more degrees) on attacks against a foe, or to defense against it, until the end of the ally's next turn. The AI aids when its own attack is poor and an ally engaged with the foe has a better one, or the ally is staggered; Aid the Champion does it by tactic. Bonuses do not stack.

name: Normal
note: The state of no condition.

name: Asleep
note: Asleep is out of the fight until recovered; noise does not wake the sleeper.

name: Blind
note: The blind fighter's attacks take total concealment penalties; being unable to see targets is not otherwise modelled.

name: Bound
note: Defenseless, immobile and impaired (a hold that scored two degrees).

name: Compelled
note: Limited to one standard action; the controller's choice of action is not simulated.

name: Controlled
note: The controlled fighter attacks one of its own side each turn; other orders are not simulated.

name: Dazed
note: One standard action; wears off at the end of the target's next turn.

name: Dead
note: Death is not simulated; the worst result is incapacitated.

name: Debilitated
note: Abilities below -5 are not tracked.

name: Deaf
note: Recognized in Affliction text but has no effect.

name: Defenseless
note: Defense counts as 0 and hits are critical; routine checks against defenseless targets are not used.

name: Disabled
note: -5 on checks, applied to attacks and resistance.

name: Dying
note: Incapacitated fighters never roll to stabilize or die.

name: Entranced
note: Treated as stunned; a hostile act does not break the trance.

name: Exhausted
note: Impaired and hindered; from extra effort fatigue or an Affliction.

name: Fatigued
note: Hindered; from extra effort or an Affliction.

name: Hindered
note: Movement is halved.

name: Immobile
note: Cannot move.

name: Impaired
note: -2 on checks, applied to attacks and resistance.

name: Incapacitated
note: Out of the fight.

name: Paralyzed
note: Defenseless, immobile and stunned.

name: Prone
note: Attack modifiers and hindered movement apply; fighters cannot drop prone or stand up.

name: Restrained
note: Hindered and vulnerable, from a hold or an Affliction.

name: Staggered
note: Dazed and hindered until recovered; a second staggering result incapacitates.

name: Stunned
note: Cannot act; a hero point can end it.

name: Surprised
note: Stunned and vulnerable until the surprise round ends.

name: Transformed
note: Recognized in Affliction text but has no effect.

name: Unaware
note: Cannot act; the unaware fighter is not treated as defenseless.

name: Vulnerable
note: Active defenses are halved, rounded up.

name: Weakened
note: Weaken costs ranks that return one per round; the Weakened condition from other sources is not tracked.

name: Hero point: Improve Roll
note: Only a missed attack roll is re-rolled (1-10 counts as 11-20); resistance checks and other rolls are not.

name: Hero point: Recover
note: Removes dazed, stunned or fatigue, or turns exhausted into fatigued.

name: Hero point: Edit Scene
note: Scene edits are not simulated.

name: Hero point: Heroic Feat
note: Borrowing an advantage with a hero point is not simulated.

name: Hero point: Inspiration
note: Hints from the GM have no combat effect.

name: Hero point: Instant Counter
note: Countering an effect as a reaction is not simulated.

name: Extra effort: +1 power rank
note: A fighter pushing an attack power gains +1 rank and a level of fatigue (applied at once, not at the start of the next turn).

name: Extra effort: extra action
note: Extra standard actions are not simulated.

name: Extra effort: +2 on a check
note: Circumstance bonuses on checks are not simulated.

name: Extra effort: power stunt
note: Temporary alternate effects are not simulated; Omni-power fighters reconfigure on their own.

name: Extra effort: extra resistance check
note: Extra recovery checks are not simulated.

name: Extra effort: +1 speed rank
note: Extra speed is not simulated.

name: Extra effort: +1 Strength rank
note: Extra Strength is not simulated.

name: Extra effort: cancel fatigue
note: A hero point can cancel the fatigue, chosen by chance right after the effort.

name: Minions: no critical hits on non-minions
note: Minions never crit heroes.

name: Minions: routine attack checks
note: A non-minion hits a minion on a routine check when 10 does it.

name: Minions: fail any Damage check and drop
note: A failed Toughness check incapacitates a minion.

name: Minions: worst degree of other effects
note: Only Damage uses the minion rule; Afflictions and other effects use normal degrees.

name: Range bands
note: Distance in arena zones gives no penalty, -2, -5 or no attack; the rank-based feet of the book and Extended Range are not used.

name: Cover
note: Pieces made of real materials give -2 (partial) or -5 (total) to attacks against whoever stands behind them, total cover blocks direct targeting, and cover adds to Dodge against area effects. Fighters use cover only when their team plays Take Cover.

name: Concealment
note: -2 or -5 to attack a target with Concealment or Invisibility; the environment itself never conceals.

name: Knockback
note: An optional community rule, off unless switched on: damage rank minus mass rank sets the distance in zones, the target falls prone, and cover or an enclosed wall can stop it or be smashed through.

name: Surprise round
note: The Ambush option gives a surprise round: surprised side stunned and vulnerable, ambushers act with one standard action.

name: Initiative
note: d20 plus Agility plus Improved Initiative; late joiners roll and slot into the order.

name: Recovery checks
note: Ongoing Affliction conditions are resisted at the end of each turn.

name: Staggered
note: Three degrees of failure on Damage stagger the target; a second one incapacitates.

name: Critical hits
note: A critical adds +5 to the resistance DC (Increased Effect); Added Effect and Alternate Effect are not used.

name: Death and dying
note: Nobody dies; the worst result is out of the fight.

name: Ongoing effects
note: Afflictions are re-checked at the end of the target's turn.

name: Area effects
note: Everyone in the zone makes a Dodge check for half; shapes and cover are not modelled.

name: Perception range
note: Perception-range effects need no attack check and cannot critically hit.

name: Defense class
note: Close attacks hit 10 + Parry, ranged attacks 10 + Dodge, vulnerable halves defenses.

name: Fatigue
note: Extra effort and Afflictions cause fatigue; exhaustion at three levels incapacitates; rest and hazards are not simulated.

name: Damaging objects
note: Cover pieces are defenseless objects: a hit at DC 10 is an automatic critical, two degrees of failure on the Toughness check punch a hole and three destroy the piece. Area attacks, shooting through cover and knockback collisions roll against it too.

name: Minions: demoralized as a group
note: Enemy minions that can see and hear the demoralizer are demoralized together by one check against the highest resistance among them; a demoralized minion of a side facing Intimidate and Break flees half again as readily.

name: Fighting Withdrawal: escape
note: Under the Fighting Withdrawal tactic a fighter who starts a turn on its own edge and is not held gets away; the team wins by getting half its fighters out, or by holding out for a set number of rounds. Escape is only a tactic: other fights never let anyone leave.
